---
name: ADR proposal
about: Propose an architectural decision worth recording.
title: "[adr] "
labels: ["adr"]
---

## Decision to make

State the decision in one sentence. ("Do X or Y?")

## Context

What's forcing the decision now? Link the relevant doc(s), open
question(s), and any research issues that produced the inputs.

## Options

List the realistic options. For each, give a one-line summary of pros and
cons. Don't list strawman options.

1. **Option A** — ...
2. **Option B** — ...
3. **Option C** — ...

## Recommendation

Which option, and why. Be explicit about what we give up.

## Done when

- [ ] ADR file added under `docs/adr/NNNN-short-title.md`.
- [ ] Relevant docs updated to reference the ADR.
- [ ] Item removed from `roadmap/open-questions.md` (or marked decided).
